description.html: The 60x45x40 cm aqua-terrarium from our workshop solves the problem of keeping species that live where water meets land. Glass of a thickness matched to the water pressure holds a 45 cm water column, with a land section above it for basking and resting.

With a floor area of 60x45 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.
Aqua-terrariums are designed for species that need both a land and a water section in their habitat:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
